title: Suction Contact Readability
purpose: Make a still frame read as Core -> tensioned tendril -> compressed sucker -> authored surface before tendrils gain locomotion authority.
allowedScope: surface-planted suction pad and compression patch
root/tendon taper, tension, and peel readability
visualTargets: suction pad never rides through free space on the reaching tip
broad sucker face terminates on the authored surface shell
ordinary attached tendrils remain short; long reach occurs only during a step
root is visibly thicker than pad-side tendon
peel keeps sucker planted while tendon lifts and seal breaks
faint surface compression patch confirms contact without adding a ring/cage
acceptanceTests: a still frame can be read as physically attached without debug text
at least two support pads remain clearly planted while one tendril reaches
reversing direction causes peel/replant rather than trailing whiskers
pulling away shows a readable planted-pad peel before disappearance
